scope: Nine 3D elasticity kernels and thirteen affine/non-affine weighted cell forms per compiler
reproduce: Run benchmarks/forms.py and benchmarks/elasticity.py compare on the variants and selected cases recorded in the embedded manifests. Pass --flags="-O3 -march=native -ffp-contract=fast -ffast-math" --cpu 2 --duration 0.1 --repetitions 9. Generate with PYTHONHASHSEED=0 and use --quadrature-from for identical non-affine and elasticity rules across versions.
